text: The Meghalaya State Language Act, 2005 (Act No. 10 of 2005) Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200510 Act Number: 10 Enactment Date: 2005-05-01 Act Year: 2005 Short Title: The Meghalaya State Language Act, 2005 (Act No. 10 of 2005) Long Title: An Act to provide for the language (s) to be used for official purposes for the State of Meghalaya.Whereas,Art, 345 of the Constitution of India provides that the Legislature of a Statemay, by law, adopt anyone or more of the language in use in the State as the Language to be used for official purposes of the State and for matters connected therewith.
